# Soance Innovations LLP

> Soance develops websites, web applications, mobile apps, custom software, automation and AI solutions for businesses.

Based in Kadirur, Kannur, Kerala, India, and serving customers in India and internationally. Business enquiries: info@soance.com; +91 8217445213. Canonical website: https://www.soance.com/.

The case-study library includes client projects and explicitly fictionalized scenarios. Fictional company identities and illustrative outcomes are not real customer evidence. Service-area pages describe places served, not separate offices. Refer to the linked pages for context.

## Company and services

- [About Soance | Software Development & Technology Consulting](https://www.soance.com/about.html.md): Meet Soance Innovations LLP, a Kerala-based technology partner building websites, mobile apps, CRMs, AI and computer vision solutions for businesses.
- [Software, Web & Mobile App Case Studies | Soance](https://www.soance.com/case-studies.html.md): Explore Soance's web, mobile app and software case studies, including client projects and clearly labeled fictional scenarios across business sectors.
- [Contact Soance | Discuss Your Website, App or Software Project](https://www.soance.com/contact.html.md): Discuss your website, app or software project with Soance in Kannur, Kerala. Call +91 8217445213 or email info@soance.com to get started.
- [Web, Mobile App & Custom Software Development | Soance](https://www.soance.com/index.md): Soance builds websites, web and mobile apps, custom software, automation and AI solutions. Based in Kannur, Kerala, serving India and global businesses.
- [Rajilesh Panoli | Founder & CEO, Soance Innovations](https://www.soance.com/me.html.md): Connect with Rajilesh Panoli, Founder and CEO of Soance Innovations, in Whitefield, Bangalore. Find his business contact details and company website.
